D/ [IMP CAE]SAR TRAIANVS HADRIAN[VS AVG] ; R/ PONT M[---]

Copper alloy coin. Sestertius of Hadrian (117-138), mint of Rome issue of 118, RIC volume 2 no. 560. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, short beard. Obverse inscription: [IMP CAE]SAR TRAIANVS HADRIAN[VS AVG]. Reverse description: Female figure standing left cradling cornucopiae and with right arm extended; [S] C in field. Reverse inscription: PONT M[---]. Diameter: 34.2mm, Weight:…
